fields.Name: T202 - Toggle Event Boolean and Save
fields.Description: Toggles a boolean/checkbox field (Is Virtual) on an Event record and saves, verifying boolean field editing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Find the 'Is Virtual' checkbox/toggle field and click it to flip its value (checked↔unchecked). An unsaved-changes banner with a 'Save Changes' button appears at the TOP — click 'Save Changes'. Verify the save succeeds with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Is Virtual' boolean field was toggled on an Event record
Save Changes was clicked and the save succeeded with no error
No error messages or crash pages
